prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Input image 1: edit target, the existing RocketWright mission-input UI draft. Preserve its exact neutral black CAD workbench, RW/RocketWright wordmark, Japanese typography, left mission panel, clear educational water-bottle rocket with dark-blue nose/fins and egg capsule, two tiny mustard-helmet gray-overall maintenance workers, top and bottom bars. Preserve the full 1672x941-style landscape composition. This is a UI proposal, not a live implemented feature.
ONE focused change: show a new EQUIPMENT SETTINGS drawer opened from a small gear button at the TOP RIGHT of the application. Match the existing app's real CAD aesthetic, flat charcoal surfaces, 1px neutral separators, small square controls, restrained blue selection and mint primary action. No neon, glowing cards, huge metrics, gradients, or marketing content.
The new gear button at the top-right is visibly selected, with the Japanese label 「設定」. Keep a small readable 「UIドラフト / 表示例」 elsewhere in the header.
Drawer: anchored to the right edge beneath the header and above the status bar, about 32% of screen width, completely covers the old right chat and a narrow portion of the canvas. The remaining scene is slightly dimmed without blur. The left mission panel and workers remain visible so this looks like an overlay on the SAME app.
Drawer header 「機材と作業環境」 with a small close X. Below, simple scope tabs 「今回の設計」 selected and 「標準設定」. Then category tabs 「プリンター」「材料」「工具」, with プリンター active. No invented brand names or vendor logos.
A structured, readable form, not a collage of cards:
- label 「使い方」, three compact radio choices 「自分の機材」「借りる」「外部に依頼」, first selected.
- label 「3Dプリンター」, dropdown 「FDMプリンター A（表示例）」, small nearby text link 「機材を追加」.
- a quiet two-column information area 「方式 FDM」「有効造形範囲 200 × 200 × 200 mm（例）」.
- label 「使用する材料」 with dropdown 「材料を選択」.
- label 「ノズル径」 with dropdown 「未選択」.
- a thin separator, heading 「使用できる工具」, compact natural checkboxes: checked 「ドライバー」「ノギス」「はかり」 and unchecked 「固定治具」.
- a thin separator and label 「組み立てる人」 with dropdown 「成人・子ども＋大人」.
- a very concise area 「設計への反映」 and three plain text lines 「部品の大きさ」「製作方法」「組立に使う工具」 with small check glyphs.
At the bottom, a pinned flat footer with a subtle amber info line 「未入力 2項目 / 製作条件は確認待ち」, a secondary outlined action 「標準設定として保存」, and one mint action 「この設計に適用」. These actions save/apply an incomplete draft profile, not manufacturing approval. A small explanatory line just above the footer 「機材を変更すると、影響する部品と手順を再確認します。」.
Keep the form field labels and critical selection text crisp and comfortably readable. The actual printer numbers are illustrative sample data, with no mechanical suitability implied. No actual machine connection, automatic device control, LLM/token jargon, or JSON printed in the user interface. Only this one application screen.
